title: Story premise ENT040: The Umbrella-Rib Observatory
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (miniature adventure). Hook: The universe is the inside of an umbrella. Takeaway/theme: A different viewpoint can expose the whole pattern.
description: A tiny astronomer wants to chart a pretend night sky inside an open umbrella, but each attempt to climb shifts the canopy and hides another star sticker. They lie flat in a suspended paper hammock between two ribs and finally see the full constellation, which outlines their missing hat.
